title: Certification transferability computed by inference, not confirmation
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (gd-0024-class-c-decisions); var seeded by migration 0027 per ADR-0064 + certification_transferability_computed_by_inference_not_confirmation wording (ADR-0060)
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Non-negotiable boundary #5; the write-time repository hard block on transferability_basis='inferred' (design overturn 7) is the companion control at a different layer. Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: cert.transferability_inferred_count (count of certification rows with transferability_basis='inferred'); the write-time repository block is the companion control and this predicate is the tripwire. ADR-0064 arms this: cert.transferability_inferred_count proves any raw-SQL bypass of the repository's write-block (the API path can never produce one) — a nonzero count IS the inference leak.
